title: Slovakian Mushroom Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from Slovakia, made with a variety of mushrooms and served with crusty bread.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the caraway seeds, tomato paste, broth, thyme, and bay leaves.
Stir to combine, then bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the stew has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over egg noodles.
